en.p: For a cubic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient $\dfrac{1}{2}$, the function $g(x)$ is
and satisfies the following conditions. What is the local minimum value of the function $g(x)$? [4 points]

box: (A) The function $g(x)$ is continuous at every real number $x\ne 1$.
(B) The function $g(x)$ has a local maximum at $x=2$, and the function $|g(x)|$ has a local minimum at $x=2$.
(C) The number of distinct real roots of the equation $g(x)=0$ is 3.
